Profile

Systems that have to stay up, built by the person who runs them.

I'm a computer engineering graduate who builds security technology end to end — the Node.js services, the Flutter apps field officers actually carry, and the self-managed Kubernetes cluster on Proxmox VE that keeps all of it running.

Right now I lead the technical side of JAGRA, a multi-service HR and security platform covering payroll, digital attendance, real-time guard patrol, and AI-based CCTV monitoring. That means backend architecture and DevOps, but equally: hardware evaluation, enterprise client integration, and the documentation that lets a distributed team ship the same thing twice.

Before that — and still, as technical expert — I worked on drone-based computer vision inspection at RA ATAP, Telkom University: crack detection on infrastructure, flood mapping from aerial imagery, and now a seismic-sensing drone programme. My continuing focus is network security and IT governance.

Technical Lead — JAGRA Integrated Security Platform

PT Global Andalan Solusi / JAGRA · Jakarta
